about.title: About us
about.description: Soberity brings together science-based education and alcohol-free experiences to support life without alcohol.
about.science: Explore articles and quizzes grounded in verifiable sources.
about.community: Discover sober parties, raves and everyday activities that bring people together.
about.heroTitle:
A clearer mind.
A fuller life.
about.heroCopy: Discover the science, explore new experiences, and find people who believe life doesn’t need alcohol to be extraordinary.

science.title: Discover the science
science.summary: Understand more. Make your own choices.
science.details: Explore source-based articles and quizzes. Follow the evidence, consider its limits, and make room for a little curiosity.

events.title: Connect through experiences
events.summary: Find your people. Try something new.
events.details: Discover alcohol-free parties and raves, sport, outdoor activities and meetups. Different ways to spend your time, with connection at their heart.

clarity.title: Discover a little more clarity.
clarity.copy: Clarity creates space for new possibilities.
clarity.note: An abstract moment of play — not a scientific model.

evidence.title: Evidence first
evidence.copy: We prioritize credible research and communicate uncertainty openly.

freedom.title: Freedom to choose
freedom.copy: We encourage alcohol-free living with support and without judgment.

together.title: Better together
together.copy: Shared experiences and community can make a new way of living feel more accessible.

about.closingTitle: There’s more to life. Explore it.
about.closingCopy: Knowledge, connection and new experiences — all in one place.

concise.headline: More life.
concise.intro: Discover the facts. Find experiences. Explore your own way to live alcohol-free.
concise.promiseCopy: Credible knowledge, room for questions and freedom to choose.

identity.title: Who are we?
identity.copy: Soberity brings credible knowledge and alcohol-free experiences together. A space for curious people who want to live alcohol-free — on their own terms.

valueDescriptions.science: We build our content on credible research, share sources and make uncertainty clear.
valueDescriptions.sober: We show how much there is to discover without alcohol — from everyday activities to parties and raves.
valueDescriptions.community: We bring people together through events, sport and meetups, making room for shared experiences.
valueDescriptions.respect: We’re not here to tell you what you can’t do. We share knowledge and show what alcohol-free living can offer. What you do with it is up to you — we’re cheering you on as you make your own informed choices. :)
